spec.accessories_upsell: AIR-CELL 48mm reinforced foil tape + AIR-CELL Spacer Biscuits (approx. 3 per m² to preserve outer air cavity).

problem_keywords: Interstitial condensation behind fibre cement / timber claddings, steel stud thermal bridging, meeting NCC mandatory R0.20 thermal break on residential steel frames.
not_for: not_for): Do not install on roofs where a Class 1/2 impermeable vapour barrier is required.
use_cases: Recommend when a steel-framed residential or commercial wall requires both an in-situ R0.20 thermal break and a vapour-permeable (Class 3) water barrier.
